deferred.missing: A prefix-wide DC fallback would misprice the blocking fee because the official SWI rule starts at minute 46 for normal DC sites but at minute 121 on the Harderstraße <=50 kW site. AC energy prices have no such own-network exception on the published table and are encoded. DE*AUC is explicitly treated as a separate operator ID and is not attributed to SWI physical assets.
